input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only TrueLink warranty in the Agreement (Section 9) is a Year 2000 readiness warranty; Sections 3 and 4 impose only "reasonable commercial efforts" service levels, and Section 8 warranties run from Client. There is no warranty that the Interface conforms to its documentation, no warranty of professional and workmanlike performance of the Hosting or Support Services, and no repair/replace/refund remedy, so the fallback fails entirely. The disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" and so will not swallow the inserted express warranty. We insert the shortest clause carrying the fallback elements (90-day software conformance, 30-day services warranty, repair/replacement or refund) immediately after Section 9.

proposal.summary: Insert an express TrueLink performance warranty for the Interface and the Hosting/Support Services with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund remedies.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 readiness, so we added a short conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface (90 days) and a professional and workmanlike warranty for the Hosting and Support Services (30 days), with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy. This is our fallback position on vendor performance warranties.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (b) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Client's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or re-performance of the non-conforming Services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
